title: Galois covers
statement:
Let $Y$ be connected with geometric point $\bar y$. A finite etale
$P\to Y$, i.e. an object of $\mathrm{F\acute Et}(Y)$ as in
[def-galois-categories], is a *Galois cover* if $P$ is
connected over $Y$ and $\operatorname{Aut}_Y(P)$ acts simply
transitively on $P_{\bar y}$.

class IsGalois {C : Type u₁} [Category.{u₂, u₁} C] [GaloisCategory C] (X : C) : Prop
    extends IsConnected X
lean.note: Use IsGalois specialized to P : Y.FiniteEtale with Y connected. Import WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.FundamentalGroup.Basic for the GaloisCategory instance and isGalois_iff; import FundamentalGroup.Connected for isConnected_of_connectedSpace and connectedSpace_of_isConnected. Together these identify IsGalois P exactly with connectedness of P.obj.left and bijective evaluation of Aut P on each geometric fibre point. A geometric point is Spec Ω → Y with Field Ω and IsAlgClosed Ω; the existing fibre functor and characterization apply through the IsSepClosed instance. No duplicate definition or chosen point parameter is needed in this intrinsic predicate.
